darwin.name: brew doctor
darwin.cmd: brew doctor; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 1 ]; then echo "(brew doctor found warnings: they are advice, not a failure)"; rc=0; fi; (exit $rc)

darwin.name: System logs review
darwin.cmd: echo '== Crash reports, last 7 days (count, process)'; find ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports /Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports -type f -mtime -7 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#.*/##; s/[-_][0-9]{4}-.*//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10; echo '== Launch agents that are not running and last exited with an error'; launchctl list | awk 'NR>1 && $1 == "-" && $2 != "0"' | head -15; echo '== Sleep blockers'; pmset -g assertions | grep -E 'Prevent(User)?Idle(System|Display)Sleep|PreventSystemSleep' | grep -v ' 0$' | head -10; echo '== Processes logging faults, last 30 min'; /usr/bin/log show --last 30m --style compact --predicate 'messageType == fault' 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $4}' | sed 's/\[.*//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10; echo '== Log folder sizes'; du -sh ~/Library/Logs /Library/Logs /private/var/log 2>/dev/null; true

darwin.name: Hardware health
darwin.cmd: echo '== Uptime and load'; uptime; echo '== Disk (SMART)'; diskutil info / | grep -E 'SMART Status|Solid State' | sed 's/^ *//'; echo '== Battery'; system_profiler SPPowerDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Cycle Count|Condition|Maximum Capacity|State of Charge' | sed 's/^ *//'; echo '== Memory'; memory_pressure -Q 2>/dev/null | tail -1; sysctl -n vm.swapusage; echo '== Time Machine'; tmutil destinationinfo 2>&1 | grep -E 'Name|Kind|No destinations' | sed 's/^ *//'; echo "local snapshots: $(tmutil listlocalsnapshots / 2>/dev/null | grep -c com.apple)"

darwin.name: Security settings
darwin.cmd: echo '== FileVault'; diskutil apfs list 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 FileVault | sed 's/^ *//'; echo '== Firewall'; /usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --getglobalstate; echo '== Gatekeeper'; spctl --status; echo '== System Integrity Protection'; csrutil status; echo '== Automatic updates'; softwareupdate --schedule; for k in AutomaticDownload AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates CriticalUpdateInstall; do echo "$k: $(defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate $k 2>/dev/null || echo unset)"; done

darwin.name: Stale project build folders
darwin.cmd: out=$(for d in ~/Dev ~/Developer ~/dev ~/Projects ~/projects ~/Code ~/code ~/src ~/work ~/Work ~/Sites ~/repos ~/git ~/Documents/GitHub; do [ -d "$d" ] && printf '%s %s\n' "$(command ls -dLi "$d" | awk '{print $1}')" "$d"; done | awk '!seen[$1]++ {sub(/^[^ ]* /, ""); print}' | while IFS= read -r root; do find "$root" -maxdepth 6 -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name target -o -name .venv -o -name venv -o -name .next -o -name .nuxt -o -name .turbo -o -name Pods -o -name .gradle -o -name DerivedData -o -name .tox -o -name .parcel-cache \) -prune -print 2>/dev/null; done | while IFS= read -r a; do p=${a%/*}; [ -n "$(find "$p" -maxdepth 4 \( -name node_modules -o -name target -o -name .venv -o -name venv -o -name .next -o -name .nuxt -o -name .turbo -o -name Pods -o -name .gradle -o -name DerivedData -o -name .tox -o -name .parcel-cache -o -name .git \) -prune -o -type f -mtime -60 -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ] && continue; du -sk "$a" 2>/dev/null; done | sort -rn | head -40); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out"; else echo "0 stale build folders found (none in a project untouched for 60 days)"; fi

darwin.name: Shell startup time
darwin.cmd: for i in 1 2 3; do /usr/bin/time -p zsh -i -c exit 2>&1 | grep real; done

darwin.name: Docker disk usage
darwin.cmd: docker system df 2>/dev/null || echo 'Docker is not running; measured the disk image without starting it'; du -h ~/Library/Containers/com.docker.docker/Data/vms/0/data/Docker.raw 2>/dev/null; true

darwin.name: Start Docker Desktop
darwin.cmd: docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { open -ga Docker && for i in $(seq 45); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 1; }

linux.name: topgrade
linux.cmd:
omega_tg_sudo() { { for c in "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}" "$HOME/Library/Application Support"; do cat "$c/topgrade.toml" 2>/dev/null; find "$c/topgrade.d" -name '*.toml' -exec cat {} + 2>/dev/null; done; } | grep -q -e '^[[:space:]]*pre_sudo[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true' -e '^[[:space:]]*sudo_loop[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true'; }; omega_space() { df -Pk "$(if [ -d /System/Volumes/Data ]; then echo /System/Volumes/Data; else echo /; fi)" 2>/dev/null | awk -v min="${OMEGA_MIN_FREE_GB:-10}" -v tool="$1" 'NR == 2 && $4 < min * 1048576 { printf "omega: only %.1f GB free on %s; %s needs room (at least %d GB) to download and unpack updates. Not running it: free space first (mo clean, omega disk) and run again.
", $4 / 1048576, $6, tool, min; exit 1 }'; }; omega_space topgrade || exit 1; if omega_tg_sudo; then c="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}"; [ -f "$c/topgrade.toml" ] || [ ! -f "$HOME/Library/Application Support/topgrade.toml" ] || c="$HOME/Library/Application Support"; d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/omega-topgrade.XXXXXX") || exit 1; printf '[misc]
pre_sudo = false
sudo_loop = false
' > "$d/omega-nosudo.toml"; { printf '[include]
paths = ['; { [ ! -f "$c/topgrade.toml" ] || echo "$c/topgrade.toml"; find "$c/topgrade.d" -name '*.toml' 2>/dev/null | sort; echo "$d/omega-nosudo.toml"; } | awk '{ printf "%s\047%s\047", (NR > 1 ? ", " : ""), $0 }'; printf ']
'; } > "$d/topgrade.toml"; echo "omega: this topgrade configuration asks for sudo at the start (pre_sudo or sudo_loop), which stops the whole run when sudo is not available; omega turns that off for this run. The steps that need sudo ask omega for it when they run (or fail on their own without it: run omega with --sudo to include them)."; topgrade --config "$d/topgrade.toml" --yes --no-retry --skip-notify; rc=$?; rm -f "$d/topgrade.toml" "$d/omega-nosudo.toml"; rmdir "$d"; (exit $rc); else topgrade --yes --no-retry --skip-notify; fi

windows.name: Disk space
windows.cmd: Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter } | Sort-Object DriveLetter | Format-Table DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, @{n='SizeGB';e={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,1)}}, @{n='FreeGB';e={[math]::Round($_.SizeRemaining/1GB,1)}} -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; foreach ($d in @($env:TEMP, "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp", "$env:SystemRoot\Temp", "$env:SystemRoot\SoftwareDistribution\Download") | Select-Object -Unique) { if (Test-Path $d) { $s = (Get-ChildItem $d -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum; '{0,8:N2} GB  {1}' -f ($s/1GB), $d } }

windows.name: System logs review
windows.cmd: '== Errors in the last 7 days (count, source)'; Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System','Application'; Level=1,2; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7)} -MaxEvents 2000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Group-Object ProviderName | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Count, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; '== Services set to start automatically that are not running'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "StartMode='Auto' AND State<>'Running'" | Select-Object -First 15 Name, State, ExitCode | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; '== Application crashes in the last 7 days'; Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; ProviderName='Application Error'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7)} -MaxEvents 200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties[0].Value } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Count, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120

windows.name: Hardware health
windows.cmd: '== Last start'; (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime; '== Restart pending'; (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending') -or (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired'); '== Disks'; Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object FriendlyName, MediaType, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; '== Memory (GB)'; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object @{n='Total';e={[math]::Round($_.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,1)}}, @{n='Free';e={[math]::Round($_.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; '== Battery'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object EstimatedChargeRemaining, BatteryStatus | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120

windows.name: Security settings
windows.cmd: '== Microsoft Defender'; Get-MpComputerStatus -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object AntivirusEnabled, RealTimeProtectionEnabled, AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated | Format-List | Out-String -Width 120; '== Firewall profiles'; Get-NetFirewallProfile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Enabled | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; '== Drive encryption (needs an elevated terminal)'; Get-BitLockerVolume -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object MountPoint, VolumeStatus, ProtectionStatus | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; '== User Account Control'; (Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).EnableLUA

windows.name: Temporary files
windows.cmd: if ($env:TEMP -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:TEMP -PathType Container)) { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:TEMP -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { $_.Delete() } else { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }
